title: LaMa (big-lama inpainting)
description: LaMa big-lama (Suvorov et al., Samsung AI, WACV 2022): fills the masked hole of an image (object removal) with a fast-Fourier-convolution network trained on scene photos.…
html:
LaMa big-lama (Suvorov et al., Samsung AI, WACV 2022): fills the masked hole of an image (object removal) with a fast-Fourier-convolution network trained on scene photos. Apache-2.0 code and weights; the Places365 training images are for research use only (see the card).

Commercial use: yes.

Details
  • Original code: https://github.com/advimman/lama at 786f5936b27f
  • Code licence: Apache-2.0 (permissive); files: LICENSE
  • Weights licence: Apache-2.0
  • Licence evidence: https://github.com/advimman/lama/blob/786f5936b27fb3dacd2b1ad799e4de968ea697e7/LICENSE ; https://github.com/advimman/lama/blob/786f5936b27fb3dacd2b1ad799e4de968ea697e7/README.md ; https://huggingface.co/smartywu/big-lama/blob/05cb2be7f8dbe6ca7c6e78f4fc827a4b2baaa4a9/README.md
  • Training data: Places365-Challenge (8 M scene images, 365 categories) (big-lama: Places365-Challenge (about 4.5 M images used) with LaMa's random wide / box masks, 256 x 256 crops (paper Sec. 4 and README).)
  • Options: cuda_graphs = True (speed only)
  • Kernel libraries: cudnn_hacc
  • Variants: big-lama
  • Not in this release (planned for 0.2.1): big-lama TensorRT export: the TensorRT ONNX parser has no DFT (FFT convolution)
  • Outputs: image
  • Input size: any H x W >= 16, padded to a multiple of 8
  • Tested up to (portable, fp16, RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB): big-lama 3000x4000 (5.1 GiB peak allocated, 6.8 reserved)
  • big-lama 512x512, first call: portable + torch.compile 26 s (cold Inductor cache).
  • big-lama original 512x512: .half() on 1 modules, fp16 inputs; advimman/lama@786f5936b27f FFCResNetGenerator, predict.py padding / masking / paste-back
  • big-lama load / first call: original 0.52 s / 0.327 s, portable 0.81 s / 0.246 s, kernels 0.72 s / 0.15 s
  • Protocol, first call, 3 warm-up, peak reset, median of 3 rounds x median of 5

Parity

CPU, float32: max |diff| <= 1e-05 vs the original. GPU, float16 (the default), portable and kernels: mean |diff| <= 0.002 and p99 <= 0.01 (absolute error of the output image).

Limitations

  • No accuracy measurement: inpainting is scored on Places / CelebA-HQ with the authors' random masks, which are not part of the evaluation data here; tiers are compared by output parity and speed only.
  • Fills the masked region from the surrounding image; it does not take a text prompt. The authors' refinement step (refine=True, an iterative multi-scale optimisation) is not implemented.
  • Any nonzero mask pixel is a hole (upstream binarises with mask > 0): anti-aliased or JPEG masks grow; threshold them first.
